paragraphs.source_en: Sales of new scales generally depend on the state of the economy. If businesses are doing well and expanding, then they buy new scales; if businesses are suffering, then they will put off buying new scales and just repair their old ones. Metro Scales also generates a good deal of revenue from its contracts—companies with a large number of scales often purchase a service contract that entitles them to service around the clock and a set rate for repairs.
